item.title: Linting Infrastructure as Code: A Deep Dive into Checkov
item.description: You spend Tuesday afternoon running a vulnerability scan against your app’s container image. Zero critical CVEs, two mediums with patches already queued up. You feel good enough about it to merge the PR and let the pipeline ship it to production. Thursday morning, someone on the platform team pings you: “hey, why is your pod running as root with a privileged security context?” You pull up the deployment YAML. There it is, three commits back, left over from when you were debugging a permissions error at 11pm and never cleaned it up. Nobody caught it — not the scanner, not code review, not the pipeline. It just shipped.
